verdict.rationale: Dagster defines pipelines as plain Python code (assets, jobs) that live in a standard project structure scaffolded via CLI, making them naturally versionable and reviewable like any codebase; docs show code-first asset definitions, project scaffolding with create-dagster/dg, and component-based config files (user/project/workspace) checked into the repo. missing for 10: explicit vendor/community statements about git-based code review workflows or CI integration specifics, and independent hands-on confirmation of portability across environments beyond docs claims.
